    Profile

    Ines is a high-elf who is in charge of ritual festivals and so forth. She's an extremely powerful divine medium, and part of the High Elf elite, but has something of a messy disposition and can often be seen at important events with terrible bed hair. Even when this happens, though, everyone will laugh it off as charmingly quirky. She doesn't like this at all, as she hates being treated like a spoiled princess.

    Origin: Northern Pride
    Gender: Female
    Height: 163cm
    Weight: 58kg
    Birthday: Apr 9
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: New things
    Hobbies: Dozing
    Illust: しぶ彦
    CV: 吉岡麻耶
